summary: Phase 24A verified end-to-end: (a) Group Info dialog avatar measured exactly 56x56 px with inline style 'width:56px; height:56px'; (b) System pin/unpin pills render correctly in DM, Group and Channel with i18n EN+FA, tap-to-jump scrolls target into view without 'not in view' toast, and long-press opens Reply/Delete menu with delete-for-everyone option for own <24h pills. All 7 acceptance criteria pass. One minor non-blocking React console warning observed: 'didFire' prop spread onto DOM button by useLongPress hook.

console_warnings.issue: React warning: 'didFire' prop is spread onto the DOM <button> element via {...lp} (output of useLongPress). Cosmetic only. Fix: destructure { didFire, ...lp } and only spread lp on the DOM element.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: In SystemPinMessage.jsx remove or filter `didFire` (and any other non-DOM props from useLongPress) before spreading on the <button>. Currently produces a 'React does not recognize the didFire prop' console warning on every render.
critical_code_review_comments: useLongPress return value is spread directly onto a DOM element ({...lp}) — fix by destructuring non-DOM properties (didFire) before spread. Functional behaviour fine.

Chat header in channel reads 'P12 ChannelChannel' when extracted via textContent because the 'Channel' kind badge is a sibling node inside chat-header-name. Cosmetically fine in UI (badge styled separately), but make sure testIds/screenshots don't get confused — not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded data: DM 015deeee... (system_pin 05f1f4cf), Group 2210e6c8... (system_pin 291c80b1 + system_unpin d4124a10 → target msg d2671a3f), Channel 7423ac3a... (system_pin ef20d3a2 → target msg e60777b4).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar testIds use UUIDs not slugs for non-DM (e.g. chat-list-item-<uuid>). DM testIds use username (chat-list-item-bob). To open a group/channel by ID, query for chat-list-item-<uuid>. Long-press in this app is simulated via page.mouse.move/down/up at pill center with 750ms hold (matches Phase 12 convention). DM clicking chat-header-name opens UserProfileDrawer (with backdrop) — to test other things after, press Escape or close the drawer first to avoid pointer interception.
